rationale: M37.21 #611 W1/W2/W3 contracts. W1 (JD18-class): object-literal methods are symbols owned by the declaring variable (util.run, local.deep); calls attribute to the method itself (run->helper, deep->inside), never to the enclosing class method or module leaf — JS parity (probed 2026-09-08). W2: subscript callees (handlers[mode]()) are SKIPPED, no fabricated 'handlers[mode]' target — JS family contract; vue-core transform.ts had 2 such fabrications. W3 (J5): static blocks and property initializers attribute to the CLASS (Service->warm, Service->init, Service->Handler), not the module leaf.
